# Getting help with job-search-prioritizer

## Where to ask

- A bug: open an issue with the [Bug report form](https://github.com/adamNBurke/job-search-prioritizer/issues/new/choose).
- An idea: open an issue with the [Feature request form](https://github.com/adamNBurke/job-search-prioritizer/issues/new/choose).
- A question, or a win you want to share: use [Discussions](https://github.com/adamNBurke/job-search-prioritizer/discussions). The [Wins category](https://github.com/adamNBurke/job-search-prioritizer/discussions/categories/wins) is for roles you found and letters you sent.
- In Claude Code, the [feedback skill](../skills/feedback/SKILL.md) (`/job-search-prioritizer:feedback`) drafts an issue for you to read, change and send yourself. It sends nothing on its own.
- To change the code yourself, read [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) before you open a pull request.
- To report a security problem, never open a public issue. Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) to report it privately.

## What to include

- Your operating system and the shell you use (bash, zsh, PowerShell, Git Bash).
- The plugin version. The [status skill](../skills/status/SKILL.md) shows it, and so does [`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`](../.claude-plugin/plugin.json).
- The JSON line the tool printed when it failed, with names, emails and folder paths removed.
- The steps that led to it, in order.

## What never to paste

Every issue and discussion here is public. Never paste your resume, your [`profile/answers.json`](../docs/data-files.md#answersjson), a ranked list with your notes, your email address, your phone number, your home folder path, or any file from your data folder. Describe what happened in your own words instead.

## How this is maintained

I maintain this in my spare time. Point releases (1.1, 1.2) come from feedback. No response time is promised, and a quiet issue is not a rejected one.
